Mustard Service Releases New Song “Sharks”
Miami-based indie rock band
Mustard Service
, consisting of Marco Rivero Ochoa (vocals/rhythm guitar), Leo Cattani (keyboard) and Adam Perez (drums), will release their upcoming fifth studio album “Paradise” on August 21, 2026.
From the album, the band released the third single called “Sharks” on July 31, 2026, following “Aerolineas Mostaza” and “Who Knew Your Body”.
Taking inspiration from the phrase “pool shark”, the track challenges the assumptions people make about things they fear or don't fully understand.
Rather than portraying sharks as calculating predators, the band lead singer Marco Rivero Ochoa reflects on how humans often create myths around danger, arguing that reality is usually far less malicious than we imagine.
Beneath its playful concept, the track becomes a reflection on perception, misunderstanding, and the stories we tell ourselves about the unknown.
It was written and produced by Mustard Service, with production by Chad Copelin.
The accompanying music video was directed by John Bryson.
Marco Rivero Ochoa said of the song, “It's human to mythologize the things that scare or hurt us, but the realities are usually far simpler and far less malicious.”
The new album comprises 12 track that the band recorded and co-produced with producer Chad Copelin.
Marco Rivero Ochoa said of the album, “I had to deal with a lot of loss over the last year, and many songs process those emotions-things left unsaid, things that should have been. I've also been having apocalyptic dreams, so mortality sneaks in. Your relationship with your producer can change everything. Watching Chad get excited enough to play and write parts for our songs is more motivating than I can put into words.”
